summary_en: The video captures a cycling race featuring athletes navigating winding roads, mountainous terrains, and urban areas. Cyclists fiercely compete and sprint across the finish line amid cheering spectators and escort motorcycles. Aerial views of the cityscape and tournament broadcast graphics are shown towards the end.
